selection: Three visually inspected generated illustrations spanning matrix/formula, gated routing, and embodied hierarchy with photographs/flow curves. Purposive coverage selection, not a random sample.
expected_behavior: Transcribe visible source text faithfully, including numerical signs and subscripts
Rebuild text and simple geometry as native editable objects
Retain intended connections, ordering, spacing and aspect ratio
Use actual PPTX LibreOffice rendering for evidence
Preserve every failed trial and bounded local repairs
Record noneditable areas and source/render differences without equating pass to fidelity
evaluation_boundary: Evaluators receive only the frozen skill instructions/references and their one raw image. No implementation contents, source prompts, other fixtures or expected scene. No source repository code executed.
